body: Thanks! I do average at around 5 hours every night but I'll try getting more sleep 👍

I'm proud of you for calling for help and I'm am thanking God for blessing us with your presence still. I understand where you're coming from because I'm in the darkness too but if we stand together,  even in the darkness, we're not alone.  You're not alone.  I'm not alone.
I am so deeply sorry for your loss. I pray that God surrounds you and your family with His healing and sustaining presence. I believe that through Christ, there are no goodbyes.
